title: Search configuration, version 3
description: Explicit owned-search configuration under SPEC-0003. Every budget is caller-supplied and there are deliberately no defaults, so a record always states the budgets that produced it. Version 2 carries the caller's extension policy under SPEC-0004; an empty list means no extension participates. Version 3 carries the selected device under SPEC-0010. The device is in the configuration rather than in provenance because verification re-runs a search from the configuration alone, so a device recorded only in provenance would describe a run that verification could not repeat.

seed.description: Deterministic seed recorded for this search.

node_limit.description: Limit on explored nodes, or null for unlimited.

time_limit_ms.description: Wall-clock limit in milliseconds, or null for unlimited.

open_node_limit.description: Bound on the open-node frontier, or null for unlimited.

improvement_tolerance.description: Absolute objective improvement required to accept an incumbent or to refuse a prune, in the original objective's units.

device.description: Device this search and its relaxations run on: "cpu", or one physical GPU UUID. One value governs the whole search because SPEC-0006 requirement 6 permits one lease holder across device selections, so a search cannot use two devices. An enumeration index is not accepted: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES renumbers devices per process, so a record carrying one could not be re-executed.

extensions.description: Extensions the caller permits, with their counted budgets. Budgets are counts rather than durations so the search path does not depend on machine speed.
